scope: W20 same-order agency history; membership service and HTTP business checks, within completed round 8 full backend run

checks.name: approved notice to artist submission and interested recipient creates one support case
scoped agency options hide private people and reject wrong identities or stale public sources
agency invitation requires artist consent; staff cannot silently accept
first commercial quote is accepted and genuinely enters paid state through simulated receipt
member alone has no artist messages or income; explicit scoped staff grant is necessary
same paid commercial conversation provides independently reviewed personal message copy
reassignment changes income visibility; revocation immediately removes messages and dashboard
removing and reinviting an employee does not resurrect the old scoped artist grant
artist withdrawal removes old agency live access without erasing contract or old income
changing agency cannot transfer historic order, commission or messages to new agency
partial refund after agency switch reverses original amounts once and does not rewrite original contract
remaining full refund archives same conversation and clears original accrual without transferring it
ended relationships, restricted proofs and withdrawn public sources cannot be reused; original invitation recovers

limits: Identity and payment receipts are synthetic
Membership removal and reinvitation use backend repository methods, message/income access uses HTTP
Seven-day handover expiry is separately tested with synthetic checkpoints and isolated time
